dct_title_s: Pacific Ocean : Gilbert Islands ; including Ocean and Nauru Islands
dct_description_sm: From a survey by the United States Exploring Expedition in 1841 with additions from British and other sources to 1935.
Depths shown by soundings and tints.
Includes navigational notes and 4 inset charts.
Textual descriptions, such as "heavy breakers" and "foul ground rep."

[Inset charts] : Makin / From a sketch by Mr. J. G. Hitchfield in 1896 with additions and corrections to 1934 -- Onotea (Clerk I.) / From a sketch survey by Master, S. S. "John Williams" in 1910 -- Beru : Espiègle Anchorage / From British sketch survey in 1884 -- Tabiteuea : Peacock Anchorage / From a survey by the United States Exploring Expedition in 1841 with corrections in 1897
